page.layout: One column of running text, left of centre; one marginal reference right of line 7; running head above the text. No page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: quidem ementita hæc gloriatio debet censeri, nisi verè Patres ip-sos designet, de quibus dixit, Tam nostri sunt, quàm Pontifex Romanus Gregorius Decimus Ter-tius. Et huc sanè incumbit ambi-tiosus ostentator: nam {*}RegnetRat.[?] 6. in Anglia, inquit, fides illa, utinam regnet, quàm hi Patres ex Scriptura extruunt, Cyprianus, Athanasius, Nazianzenus, Ambrosius, Hie-ronymus, Chrysostomus, Augusti-nus, & Gregorius Latinus.

Hos ille Patres recensuit (De-us bone!) in hac causa nostra (nisi insanissimè fallor) ipsissi-mos Patronos nostros, quibus [illegible, ~9 letters] adjunximus octo alios, Origenem, Tertullianum, Hila-rium,

page.notes: The Greek word after "quibus" is not legible enough to transcribe. The margin reference after "Regnet" reads as "Rat. 6." but "Rom. 6." (Romans 6:12, "non ergo regnet peccatum") is likely; left as printed, with [?]. Italic/roman boundaries in lines 8–10 are approximate.
